text:
Let's redo Sora's BACK-DASH. My director said your earlier back-dash sheet (attached, image 2) looks like a normal jump, not a back-dash. It must be a QUICK, LOW BACKSTEP: a short, fast hop straight backward (toward screen left, away from the opponent) that barely leaves the floor - the feet only lift a little and he travels back much more than he goes up. The same animation is also used in the air.




Attached: (1) my director's pose reference for the back-dash (another character, pose only): body upright to slightly leaning back, knees bent with the feet out in front of him, arms out for balance, weapon held low behind; (2) your earlier sheet - do NOT repeat its high, tucked jumping poses; (3) Sora's battle idle in our style.




Please generate an image: a clean concept sheet of Sora's back-dash, facing screen right, plain white background, the same 2D cel style, KH2 outfit and Kingdom Key as the attached Sora sprite, the same size in every pose, no text or labels. 5 poses in order:

1. Battle idle, weight shifting back (start).

2. Push off: a quick push from the front foot, body tipping back, feet just leaving the floor.

3. Mid back-dash (the main pose, like the reference): body upright leaning slightly back, knees bent with feet out in front, LOW off the ground; Keyblade in his RIGHT hand only, held low and behind him; left arm out for balance.

4. Feet reaching back down to the floor.

5. Landing back in the battle idle (both hands on the Keyblade), sliding to a stop.
